dedupe_keys.name: the design capacity of the local refineries in kingdom

description: The Design Capacity of the Local Refineries in Kingdom is a dataset listed in KAPSARC Data Portal, an energy economics open data portal, published or maintained by King Abdullah Petroleum Studies and Research Center (KAPSARC). Rabigh Refinery changed its name to Petro Rabigh in October 2008 Satrup Refinery began operating ( Saudi Aramco refinery and Total ) in late 2013 Yaserf Refinery began operating ( Saudi Aramco and Sinopec ) in late 2015. Coverage: as titled: Saudi Arabia, the Gulf states, India or the world (see the dataset page). The portal flags it as a time series. The portal files it under Conventional Fuels. Its keywords are Samref, Sasref, Yasref, Satorp, Petro Rabigh. The portal shows 2016-04-18 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy, water and transport system studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kapsarc-open-data-portal.
